**Finding: compliant (preferred level) — no redline proposed.**

The IP/data package across §§ 13–15 already sits at our preferred position:

- **Deliverables ownership + assignment** — § 14.2 vests ownership in Customer on creation and includes a present assignment of all worldwide right, title and interest, with personnel assignments and further assurances.
- **Vendor pre-existing IP** — § 14.3 limits Vendor's retained rights to "Vendor Technology," which § 1.9 defines as pre-existing technology and expressly excludes Customer Data and Customer's pre-existing IP.
- **Embedded Vendor IP licence** — § 13.2 grants Customer and its Affiliates a "perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free, fully paid licence" including modification and derivative works, and § 13.3 bars revocation except for uncured material payment/use breach.
- **Customer Data** — § 14.1 confirms Customer ownership and that no right transfers to Vendor beyond a limited processing right; § 15.1 bars sale, advertising use, cross-customer combination and model training. No aggregated/derived-data exploitation licence exists anywhere.
- **No joint ownership** — § 14.4 negates it absent a separate signed instrument, and preserves Customer's unrestricted use of its own feedback.

Noted in the rationale only (not redlined): the processing right also mentions "improve the Services for Customer," and § 13.2 permits contractor support rather than a general sublicence — neither is required by the preferred checklist, so we have not proposed changes.
